items.title: Graduation Rates Stay Above State Levels
items.summary: Orange County’s graduation rate reached 93.1% in 2024-25, outpacing California by 4.4 points and holding steady near 93% over the past three years.
items.detail: Orange County continues to outperform the state on graduation rate. The county posted 93.1% in 2024-25 compared with California’s 88.7%, following 92.9% in 2023-24 and 93.3% in 2022-23. The pattern suggests sustained strength in completion outcomes across the county.

items.title: Chronic Absenteeism Continues to Improve
items.summary: Countywide chronic absenteeism fell to 14.3%, well below the statewide rate of 19.4% and down nearly five points from 2022-23.
items.detail: Countywide chronic absenteeism continues to improve. Orange County’s rate dropped to 14.3% in 2024-25, compared with 15.2% in 2023-24 and 19.2% in 2022-23. The county remains well below California’s 19.4% statewide rate.

items.title: Suspension Rates Remain Below Statewide Levels
items.summary: Orange County’s suspension rate held at 1.8% in 2024-25, remaining below California’s 2.9% and continuing a multi-year decline.
items.detail: Suspension rates in Orange County continue to trend downward. The county reported 1.8% in 2024-25, compared with 2.1% in 2023-24 and 2.4% in 2022-23. This remains below the statewide rate of 2.9%.

items.title: Math Proficiency Continues to Climb
items.summary: Orange County students met or exceeded standards in math at 49.2%, widening the county’s lead over the state to nearly 12 points.
items.detail: Recent CAASPP results show continued gains in mathematics. Orange County reached 49.2% met or exceeded in 2024-25, up from 47.9% in 2023-24 and 46.8% in 2022-23. The county continues to outperform California’s 37.3% statewide rate.

items.title: ELA Achievement Remains Strong
items.summary: Orange County students met or exceeded standards in ELA at 58.9%, staying well ahead of the state and improving modestly over time.
items.detail: Orange County’s ELA performance remains above the statewide average. The county posted 58.9% met or exceeded in 2024-25, compared with 57.6% in 2023-24 and 57.4% in 2022-23. California’s statewide rate was 48.8%.

items.title: More Students Are Meeting A-G Requirements
items.summary: Orange County’s A-G completion rate reached 54.9%, staying well above the statewide rate of 47.2% and improving across recent years.
items.detail: College readiness remains a strength for Orange County. The county’s A-G completion rate increased to 54.9% in 2024-25, up from 52.6% in 2023-24 and 52.5% in 2022-23. The county continues to exceed California’s statewide rate of 47.2%.

items.title: English Learner Trends Are Showing Gradual Improvement
items.summary: At-risk LTEL rates remain below the statewide rate, while the overall LTEL share has declined since 2024-25.
items.detail: English learner accountability indicators show a mixed but improving picture. In 2025-26, Orange County’s At-Risk LTEL rate was 10.7%, below California’s 12.2%. The LTEL share was 20.0%, down from 21.7% in 2024-25 and 21.0% in 2023-24, while the statewide LTEL rate was 18.8%.
